```{r}
iterate_parameters <- function(data, m_0, s2_0, a, b, alpha_0, beta_0, previous) {
    next_parameters <- list()
    mu_1 <- previous$mu_1
    mu_2 <- previous$mu_2
    pi <- previous$pi
    sigma2 <- previous$sigma2
    zs <- previous$zs
    z_i <- numeric(n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      y_i <- data[i]
      p_1 <- dnorm(y_i, mu_1, sigma2)*pi/
        (pi*dnorm(y_i, mu_1, sigma2)+(1-pi)*dnorm(y_i, mu_2, sigma2))
      if (runif(1, 0, 1) < p_1) {
        z_i[i] <- 1
      } else {
        z_i[i] <- 2
      }
    }
    zs <- z_i
    next_parameters$zs <- zs
    
    N_1 <- sum(sapply(zs, function(x) x == 1))
    pi <- rbeta(1, a + N_1, b + n - N_1)
    next_parameters$pi <- pi
    
    y_bar_1 <- sum(data[which(sapply(zs, function(x) x == 1))])
    mu_1 <- rnorm(1, 
                  (m_0 + y_bar_1)/(sigma2 + s2_0*N_1),
                  (s2_0*sigma2)/(sigma2+s2_0*N_1)
    )
    next_parameters$mu_1 <- mu_1
    N_2 <- sum(sapply(zs, function(x) x == 2))
    y_bar_2 <- sum(data[which(sapply(zs, function(x) x == 2))])
    mu_2 <- rnorm(1, 
                  (m_0 + y_bar_2)/(sigma2 + s2_0*N_2),
                  (s2_0*sigma2)/(sigma2+s2_0*N_2)
    )
    next_parameters$mu_2 <- mu_2

    alpha_k = alpha_0 + n/2
    beta_k_1 = beta_0 + 1/2 * sum((data-mu_1)^2)
    beta_k_2 = beta_0 + 1/2 * sum((data-mu_2)^2)
    sigma2 = pi * 1/rgamma(1, alpha_k, beta_k_1) + (1-pi) * 1/rgamma(1, alpha_k, beta_k_2)
    next_parameters$sigma2 <- sigma2
    next_parameters
}

gibbs_sampler <- function(data, samples_count, m_0, s2_0, a, b, alpha_0, beta_0, burn) {
  n <- length(data)
  parameters <- vector(mode="list", length=samples_count)
  #Initialise prior values from distribution
  parameters[[1]] <- list(
    mu_1 = rnorm(1, m_0, s2_0),
    mu_2 = rnorm(1, m_0, s2_0),
    pi = rbeta(1, a, b),
    sigma2 = 1/rgamma(1, alpha_0, beta_0)
  )
  parameters[[1]]$zs = rbinom(n, 1, 1-parameters[[1]]$pi) + 1
  for (t in 2:samples_count) {
    parameters[[t]] <- iterate_parameters(data, m_0, s2_0, a, b, alpha_0, beta_0, parameters[[t-1]])
  }
  parameters
}
```

```{r}
results <- gibbs_sampler(faithful$eruptions, 100, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0)
```
